analysis: Elasticity exactly at the pre-game-rating reference
reason: The price magnitude is zero at the reference, so a proportional price change and log derivative are undefined.

A structural subjective cost would require specifying and identifying v(win payoff)-v(draw payoff), including reference curvature and loss aversion. The paper estimates reduced-form behavior and does not impose that primitive.
Draw payoff and relative rating are the same ordering variable under the Glicko update and are not randomly assigned. Estimates are within-chooser conditional associations, not causal price effects.
